# RIP - shared regional government.
on_startup = {
	rip_rg_cleanup_effect = yes
	rip_rg_grain_refresh_effect = yes
}

on_monthly_pulse = {
	rip_rg_cleanup_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = rip_rg_ods_export
		}
		rip_rg_grain_refresh_effect = yes
	}
}

on_reform_changed = {
	rip_rg_cleanup_effect = yes
	rip_rg_grain_refresh_effect = yes
}

on_province_owner_change = {
	rip_rg_province_transfer_effect = yes
}
